{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (invalid)
valid_ages = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Output the result
mean_age"}
